t: The Mira Apt ERD rear-fed exposed thermostatic diverter mixer shower provides reliable performance and control for all plumbing systems. This chrome finished unit is ideal for bathroom upgrades and new installations, featuring a maximum temperature stop with override for enhanced safety, alongside separate controls for precise temperature and flow adjustments. The integrated diverter allows seamless switching between the single-spray 20cm deluge head and practical 9cm hand shower. Cool Shield technology prevents the valve from heating up during operation, ensuring comfort and safety. Rub-clean nozzles on both shower heads simplify limescale removal for easy maintenance.
